Geographies Served Programs Parivaar Bengal District Kolkata South 24 Parganas State West Bengal District Kolkata South 24 Parganas States West Bengal Parivaar runs two institutions in West Bengal, the Vivekananda Sevashrama for Boys and Parivaar Sarada Teertha for Girls. Children from the age of four to twenty-one are present in the institutions. The institutions admit children who have nobody to care for them and help them to achieve their dreams of education. Parivaar acts as a family to these children supporting them from childhood to self-sufficiency till they attain jobs. Parivaar takes efforts to admit siblings together if possible to provide them with a familial atmosphere as far as possible. Parivaar MP Seva Kutirs District Sehore Vidisha Khandwa Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Jhabua Mandla Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Harda Dewas Betul State Madhya Pradesh District Sehore Vidisha Khandwa Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Jhabua Mandla Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Harda Dewas Betul States Madhya Pradesh Parivaar works in some of the districts of Madhya Pradesh that are majorly inhabited by tribal communities. Parivaar kutirs which are run in different pockets of Madhya Pradesh take care of the malnourishment among children by providing them with a healthy and balanced diet. It also provides supplementary education and life skills to the children. Parivaar MP 24*7 Ambulance Services and Mobile Health Clinics District Balaghat Hoshangabad Sehore Seoni Vidisha Dhar Khargone Khandwa Barwani Burhanpur Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Jhabua Mandla Shahdol Umaria Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Harda Dewas Betul Alirajpur State Madhya Pradesh District Balaghat Hoshangabad Sehore Seoni Vidisha Dhar Khargone Khandwa Barwani Burhanpur Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Jhabua Mandla Shahdol Umaria Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Harda Dewas Betul Alirajpur States Madhya Pradesh Parivaar operates a hundred and thirty ambulances in the areas of Madhya Pradesh, in and around where its Seva Kutirs are located. These ambulances are deployed to ferry patients to the nearest hospitals from interior village locations and also reach sites of accidents for emergency service. The vehicles are also used as mobile clinics to conduct daily mobile medical camps and people who are referred for specialised treatment are transported to the nearest hospitals and cities if need be. Parivaar Shravan Kumar Prakalpa :Vision Restoration Programme for Elderly District Chhatarpur Sagar Hoshangabad Rajgarh Sehore Seoni Tikamgarh Dhar Khargone Khandwa Burhanpur Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Jhabua Mandla Shahdol Umaria Anuppur Damoh Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Shajapur Raisen Harda Guna Dewas Betul Singrauli Alirajpur Ashoknagar State Madhya Pradesh District Chhatarpur Sagar Hoshangabad Rajgarh Sehore Seoni Tikamgarh Dhar Khargone Khandwa Burhanpur Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Jhabua Mandla Shahdol Umaria Anuppur Damoh Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Shajapur Raisen Harda Guna Dewas Betul Singrauli Alirajpur Ashoknagar States Madhya Pradesh The organisation, partnering with Shri SadguruSevaSangh Trust Eye Hospital, Anandpur, District Vidisha and Sri SadguruSevaSangh Trust Eye Hospital, Chitrakoot provides eye-related medical services to elderly people. It helps the hospitals by conducting outreach camps, information about which is distributed by the organisation to villages in advance. It also transports people with eye issues to the camp location and arranges for them to reach the hospital centres if referred for further treatment. It sponsors the cost of travel of the patient to the hospital premises while the hospitals themselves take care of the cost of treatment. Volunteers of the organisation mobilize the patients and assist them during their visits to the hospital and are with them till they safely return to their homes. Residential Institutions District Sehore Mandla District Sehore Mandla Children are selected from remote and poor tribal villages and also from difficult areas and backgrounds from urban areas. These children are selected based on an elaborate neediness assessment.Each resident child once admitted into the residential institution is under the care and custody of Parivaar till higher education and subsequent job placement and settlement into the future phase of life. For example, children showing aptitude for meritorious professional lines will be trained and fully supported (just as parents do for their own children) till completion of that higher education and subsequent placement. Children stay in the campus in hostels, study in Parivaar's own schools and also get all the facilities like sports, medical, clothes etc 24*7 Ambulance Services District Balaghat Sehore Seoni Vidisha Dhar Khandwa Barwani Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Mandla Shahdol Umaria Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Betul Alirajpur District Balaghat Sehore Seoni Vidisha Dhar Khandwa Barwani Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Mandla Shahdol Umaria Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Betul Alirajpur These ambulances run 24*7 in remote and poor tribal areas in Madhya Pradesh, and transport patients to the nearby hospitals. Seva Kutirs (Supplementary Meals Cum Education Centres) District Sehore Vidisha Khandwa Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Mandla Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Harda Betul District Sehore Vidisha Khandwa Ratlam Chhindwara Dindori Mandla Anuppur Sheopur Sidhi Shivpuri Harda Betul These are supplementary meals cum education day boarding centres in tribal villages in Madhya Pradesh. These are run in morning and evening shifts (7 to 10 am) & 4 to 7 pm. Children get meals as well as are educated by teachers. Vision and Mission Our vision is to reach as many children and youth as possible throughout India and help transform their lives. Our mission is to bring about transformation in lives of suffering humanity through earnest humanitarian work, and in particular change the lives of destitute and vulnerable children and youth in a loving and caring environment, creating the soil on which children can realize their full potential, and through the benefits of long-term education, livelihood training, and hand-holding.
